• Target: Increase renewable energy share to 35%.

 TECHNOLOGY & GROWTH STRATEGY
• Focus on AI-driven operations and technology-led growth.
• Priorities include cost leadership, disciplined project execution and better resource utilisation.
🎯
 CONCALL TAKEAWAY
Record earnings, lower cost guidance, strong cash generation and a significant silver contribution support the company's growth outlook. Expansion projects remain on track.

- Accidental damage to the existing pipeline caused discharge of treated effluent water into the estuary

- Company required to submit details of existing and proposed strengthened monitoring systems for the pipeline
- Directions include a Bank Guarantee of INR 10 Lakh and Environmental Damage Compensation to be determined by the Authority
- Affected pipeline has been repaired and is ready to take fresh treated effluent water load

📌
 OPTICAL FIBRE & DATA CENTRE BUSINESS
• ₹1,800 Cr planned investment across optical fibre, cable and preform manufacturing.
• Optical fibre capacity to increase from 28 million to 43 million units; cable capacity to rise from 34 million to 63 million fibre-kilometres.
• Connectivity solutions revenue targeted at over ₹800 Cr in FY27 and ₹2,000 Cr in FY28.
• Management sees strong demand from AI infrastructure, hyperscalers, data centres and telecom operators, with no significant slowdown currently observed.
• Around 70% of the ₹18,500 Cr optical fibre and data centre interconnect order book was indicated to be linked to hyperscalers.
